name: ZaiNar
description: ZaiNar is privately held and has no ticker. Review its funding rounds and valuation, its investors, and the points to confirm before buying or selling.
ledes: ZaiNar is a privately held positioning technology company. Its shares are not listed on an exchange and have no quoted market price; the principal public reference points are the valuations at which the company has raised capital. Its most recent financing, announced on February 19, 2026, valued the company at more than $1 billion.

Founded in 2017 and based in Belmont, California, ZaiNar has developed technology that synchronizes timing across existing 5G and Wi-Fi networks so that those networks can determine the location of connected devices. Existing shares change hands in privately negotiated transactions and remain subject to the company's transfer restrictions.
figs: Total investment stated by the company (February 2026)
table_note: The February 2026 valuation is as announced by the company, which did not name the series or state the size of that financing. The Series A amount is as reported in the company's 2021 Form D filing with the SEC.
round_notes: ZaiNar announced the February 2026 financing when it emerged from nine years of operating in stealth, and it did not name a lead investor. At that time, the company said it had received more than $100 million in investment in total; that figure is the company's own.

A round valuation reflects the terms of the preferred stock issued in that round. Most shares sold by employees are common stock, which carries fewer rights and typically trades at a discount to the preferred price.
investors: ZaiNar has not named a lead investor for its financings. Investors identified by the company include Steve Jurvetson, who serves on its board, as well as Jerry Yang, Jaan Tallinn, Nicholas Pritzker and Tom Gruber.
spv_sentence: SEC filings show one special purpose vehicle formed to invest in ZaiNar, organized in 2021.
sources: Sources: ZaiNar's announcement dated February 19, 2026; the company's Form D filing for its Series A (October 2021); and SEC Form D filings.
